                                        ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current Cl-2, Neighborhood Commercial District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 4-F in the area bounded by:

              A line 75.0 feet north of and parallel to West Cullerton Street; the public alley next
              east of and parallel to South Jefferson Street; a line 25.0 feet south of and parallel
              to West Cullerton Street; and South Jefferson Street

to those ofan B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 1931 -33 South Jefferson Street

11. Current Use ofthe property            vacant lot and one two story residential building

12. Reason for rezoning the property: to rezone thc propertv to sub-divide the zoning lots into
    two lots and construct three story residential building with three dwelling units and a
    detached three car garage on each lot.
13.     Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate thc number of
dwelling units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space;
and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)                  The subject property is comprised of a
double lot that is 5.000 square feet known as 1931 and 1933 South Jefferson Street. The lot known as 1931
South Jefferson Street is a vacant lot. The lot known as 1933 South Jefferson is improved with a vacant
two story residential building with two dwelling units and no parking. The Applicant proposes to rezone
the property to split the zoning lots and construct a three story residential building with three dwelling units
and a detached three car garage at 1931 South Jefferson Street and to demolish the existing structure at
1933 South JefTcrson Street and also construct a new three story residential building with three dwelling
units and a detached three car garage • The proposed height of each building is 47'-2". Thc Applicant
will comply with section 17-3-0307 exceptions if applicable.
